recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31382 unless OO separately chooses to revise broader blood-pressure component-observation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-31382 is an Applied FHIR-core OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6, asking that the Vital Signs Observation.value[x] definition stop implying cuff size can be supplied as the vital-sign value. The approved resolution replaces Observation.value[x] with 'The quantity for the vital sign being observed.' and Observation.component.value[x] with 'The value for the vital sign component being observed.'.
initial_application: Jira comment says the change was applied in e57230c51e. That commit changed source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml by removing the old blood-pressure-cuff-size wording from both Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x] and inserting the approved replacement text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Observation as an active resource and source/observation/implementationguide-Observation-vitalsigns.xml includes StructureDefinition/vitalsigns, confirming the inspected profile source is in current build scope. The referenced Zulip thread confirms cuff size is a component or separate supporting observation rather than BP Observation.value[x], and OO 2025-09-15 WGM minutes record FHIR-31382 as applied. Later nearby vital-sign profile work did not alter or contradict the FHIR-31382 definitions.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source already has Observation.value[x] defined as 'The quantity for the vital sign being observed.' and Observation.component.value[x] defined as 'The value for the vital sign component being observed.'. The only remaining cuff-size wording found is narrative guidance about additional blood-pressure component observations, not the misleading value[x] definition targeted by the issue.
